name: type:feature
description: New capability in a block or the factory

name: type:bug
description: Something is wrong and must be fixed

name: type:spec
description: Change to a HAS, MAS, plan, PRD or spec

name: type:bkm
description: Change to a BKM, skill or the glossary

name: type:infra
description: CI, tools, repo settings

name: type:research
description: Find something out; ends in a written finding

name: type:epic
description: Parent issue whose sub-issues land together through an epic branch

name: area:rtl
description: Hardware implementation and its HAS and MAS

name: area:dv
description: Simulation and verification

name: area:fv
description: Formal verification

name: area:fpga
description: FPGA implementation: Quartus, pins, timing, boards

name: area:scripts
description: Host scripts bound to a project or a common block

name: area:sw
description: Software that runs on the design's own CPU

name: area:workflow
description: How the factory works: BKMs, skills, CI, GitHub

name: priority:P0
description: Drop everything: main is broken or blocked

name: priority:P1
description: Next up

name: priority:P2
description: Normal

name: priority:P3
description: Someday

name: size:minimal
description: A one-line or wording fix

name: size:small
description: One block, document or tool; under about 100 changed lines

name: size:medium
description: One block or tool with its spec and tests; up to about 400 lines

name: size:large
description: Several blocks or documents; still one crewmate and one pull request

name: size:xlarge
description: More than one crewmate or pull request; split it or make it an epic

name: complexity:low
description: Mechanical; the method and the answer are known

name: complexity:medium
description: Known method, design choices inside existing patterns

name: complexity:high
description: New design or open questions; grill or research first

name: status:triage
description: New; not yet clear or not yet labelled

name: status:ready
description: Clear and labelled; can be assigned

name: status:in-progress
description: A crewmate is working on it

name: status:in-review
description: Pull request open; in review

name: status:blocked
description: Waiting on another issue or an outside fact

name: authority:needs-captain
description: A captain must say the pull request is ready before it lands; set only by a captain
